key_insight: Fine-tuned MACE simulations reveal temperature-dependent Li⁺ dynamics in Li₆PS₅Cl, with localized, nonlinear low-dimensional motion below 500 K and competing Li⁺–framework dynamics at 500–700 K.
engineering_relevance: Understanding how framework motion influences lithium transport could guide solid-electrolyte design and temperature-aware modeling.
method: Molecular dynamics using a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential.
Essential dynamics analysis of eigenspectra and low-dimensional trajectory embeddings.
Langevin simulations testing how framework damping affects Li⁺ dynamics.
evidence_signal: Temperature-resolved eigenspectra and embeddings show nonmonotonic behavior at 500–700 K, supported by framework-damping simulations.
watch_item: The abstract does not report quantitative potential errors or experimental validation, leaving predictive accuracy across temperatures to be assessed.
paper_title: Temperature-Dependent Ion Dynamics in Argyrodite Superionic Conductor Li$_{6}$PS$_{5}$Cl with Fine-Tuned MACE Foundation Model
